style: sun-drenched golden dune oil painting with sandstone obelisks, turquoise oasis shimmer, and warm ochre haze
rules: Each item belongs to a unified tabletop cosmetic collection sharing the exact same palette, brushwork, and motif. No text, letters, numbers, logos, or borders.
spare: an extra painting in the same style: a wide serene tabletop playmat evoking Desert Mirage

a painterly fantasy portrait bust of Dune Nomad in the theme of Desert Mirage. A centered bust portrait medallion subject with dramatic workshop lighting and clean silhouette.

an adorable small magical tabletop companion creature, Sand Fennec, matching Desert Mirage. A charming tabletop companion creature in full-body view centered with breathing room around it on a deep moody background.
a circular ornamental portrait frame medallion titled Sunstone Rim in the style of Desert Mirage. An ornate circular portrait border motif with clean dark interior so an avatar sits inside it.
an ornate vertical Command-Zone card border frame titled Oasis Command matching Desert Mirage. An ornate vertical rectangular border frame for a commander card slot with a calm dark interior center.

the BACK of a playing card in the same style: a symmetrical ornamental design (it is seen upside down too) with a central emblem drawn from this set's theme, framed by a painted border; no logo, no oval, no five dots, no lettering
